sources.title: NexaAI/Qwen3-8B-NPU · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Description Qwen3-8B is an 8-billion-parameter large language model developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud. It sits in the mid-range of the Qwen3 family, offering a strong balance between capability and efficiency — ideal for both enterprise-scale applications and high-performance local inference.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B — Alibaba Model with Hybrid Thinking/Non-Thinking Reasoning ...
sources.snippet: The model supports 119 languages and dialects (vs. 29 in Qwen2.5), covering Indo-European, Sino-Tibetan, Afro-Asiatic, Austronesian and other language families. In terms of agent capabilities, Qwen3-8B integrates well with external tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol), supporting function calls in both thinking and non-thinking modes.

sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B: Efficient model for productive AI projects
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B is a powerful open source language model from the third Qwen generation of Alibaba Cloud. It was developed for sophisticated language processing, efficient inference and flexible integration - ideal for productive applications in companies, research and development. With 8 billion parameters, the model offers a strong balance of computing power, context understanding and compactness ...
